enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed breakfast with coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, butter. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take out mug. Add coffee to mug. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Stir coffee. Add milk. Spread butter on toast. Take toast out of toaster. Place toast on plate. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room, dusting and vacuuming
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up items on floor. Place items in basket. Pick up dust cloth. Wipe coffee table. Wipe TV stand. Wipe shelves. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Move sofa. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Put away vacuum cleaner. Put away dust cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone messages and planning the week ahead on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Press home button. Open messaging app. Scroll through messages. Type reply. Put down phone. Open laptop computer. Turn on computer. Open calendar app. Check appointments. Open email. Read emails. Type notes. Open planning document. Write tasks. Save document. Close computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the shops for grocery shopping and running errands
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open door. Walk out. Walk down street. Enter shop. Pick up basket. Walk to produce section. Pick up apples. Place in basket. Walk to dairy section. Pick up milk. Place in basket. Walk to checkout. Pay for items. Put items in bags. Walk out of shop. Walk to post office. Send package. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting away groceries and preparing and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Place bags on counter. Open refrigerator. Put milk in refrigerator. Put vegetables in refrigerator. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Put pasta in cupboard. Close cupboard. Take out lettuce from refrigerator. Take out tomato from refrigerator. Wash lettuce. Chop tomato. Take out plate. Place lettuce and tomato on plate. Pour dressing. Sit at table. Eat salad.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV while relaxing after lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch another program. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a walk in the park and stopping for a coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Put on jacket. Open door. Walk to park. Walk along path. Stop at bench. Sit on bench. Look around. Stand up. Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order coffee. Pay. Pick up coffee. Sit at table. Drink coffee. Stand up. Walk out. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a book and resting quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Adjust pillow. Continue reading. Close book. Put down book. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up game controller. Turn on TV. Turn on game console. Select game. Start game. Press buttons. Move controller. Play game. Pause game. Resume game. Play game. Turn off game console. Turn off TV. Put down controller.

enriched_activities.activity: Browsing on the computer and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Open browser. Type website. Scroll page. Click link. Open music app. Select playlist. Play music. Adjust volume. Continue browsing. Close browser. Close music app. Turn off computer.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken and vegetables. Close refrigerator. Take out rice. Wash rice. Put rice in cooker. Add water. Turn on cooker. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

Enter living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch news. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch show. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a movie with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Select movie. Play movie. Sit on sofa. Watch movie. Adjust volume. Pause movie. Go to bathroom. Return. Resume movie. Watch. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening wash and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wash face. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off water. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and scrolling on the phone in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll feed. Like post. Comment. Close app. Put down phone. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to other side. Sleep.
